children: The 287-key hotel in Khopoli, Maharashtra, will be acquired from Imagicaaworld Entertainment

Juniper Hotels Limited has approved the proposed acquisition of Novotel Imagicaa, a 287-key operating hotel in Khopoli, Maharashtra, from Imagicaaworld Entertainment for a cash consideration of Rs 248 crore.
The company has entered into a binding memorandum of understanding (MoU) for the transaction, which values the hotel at approximately Rs 86 lakh per key.

Located along the Mumbai-Pune corridor and adjacent to the Imagicaa Theme Park and Water Park, the hotel is spread across 11 acres and has a built-up area of around 2,80,000 sq ft. The property includes guest rooms, dining facilities, banquet venues and recreational facilities.
The hotel caters to leisure and social demand as well as meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions (MICE).

According to Juniper Hotels Chairman and Managing Director Arun Kumar Saraf, the company plans to add the hotel to its portfolio without the development timeline associated with a new property. The company also plans to expand the property's banqueting capacity and evaluate rebranding it in the upper-upscale segment.
Juniper Hotels currently owns and operates seven luxury and upper-upscale hotels comprising 1,895 keys, including 245 serviced apartments, across major cities in India.
Its portfolio includes Grand Hyatt Mumbai Hotel and Residences, Andaz Delhi and Residences, Hyatt Regency Ahmedabad, Hyatt Regency Lucknow, Hyatt Raipur and Hyatt Place Hampi.
